body.text: How close is TZX to Trabzon center (15 min) and Sümela Monastery (55 min)?

[Trabzon Airport (TZX)](https://dhmi.gov.tr/sayfalar/havalimani/trabzon/anasayfa.aspx) sits 7 kilometers from Meydan Park in central Trabzon according to [DHMİ Trabzon transport records](https://dhmi.gov.tr/sayfalar/havalimani/trabzon/Ulasim.aspx), taking 15 minutes by car outside peak hours. Sümela Monastery in Altındere Valley lies roughly 48 kilometers south, requiring 55 minutes to reach the lower shuttle parking area before the park transfer up to the cliffside trail.

Because the terminal sits directly north of the D010 Trabzon–Rize highway, leaving the airport is straightforward. Havaş buses and local minibuses serve central Trabzon and coastal districts, while travelers heading straight to Maçka or Sümela Monastery benefit from a pre-arranged vehicle so luggage remains secure during the monastery visit.

body.text: Should you pick up a 4x4 at TZX or hire a local yayla driver?

Hiring a local Black Sea driver with a high-clearance van or 4x4 is the safer choice for travelers heading to upper yaylas such as Pokut, Sal, Gito, or Hıdırnebi. Self-driving a rental 4x4 from TZX works fine for paved valleys like Maçka and Uzungöl, but steep unpaved mountain tracks and sudden fog catch visiting drivers off guard.

Rental desks at TZX stock compact cars and standard SUVs, yet true low-range 4x4 vehicles are scarce in July and August unless reserved months ahead. Even with a capable vehicle, local drivers know passing pullouts, afternoon cloud patterns, and which highland tracks remain passable after heavy rain.
Decision Checklist for TZX Ground Transport:

items: Choose a local yayla driver if your route includes unpaved plateaus above 1,800 meters or tight multi-stop days.
Choose a rental SUV at TZX only if sticking to paved coastal roads, Sümela Monastery, and Uzungöl.
Confirm full collision coverage for unpaved roads before signing any rental contract at TZX.
Pack rain layers and offline maps regardless of your vehicle, as mobile coverage drops in deep valleys.

body.text: What summer peak traffic affects the coastal highway?

Between late June and early September, heavy regional tourism and holiday traffic slow the D010 Black Sea coastal highway through Yomra, Arsin, and Of. A 15-minute airport transfer into central Trabzon can stretch to 35 minutes on Friday afternoons, while the Uzungöl turnoff at Of frequently backs up between 11:00 and 16:00.

Summer also brings a sharp surge in direct seasonal flights to TZX from Gulf cities alongside domestic flights from Istanbul and Ankara. Departing travelers in July and August should leave Uzungöl at least four hours before domestic flights and five hours before international departures to absorb coastal highway queues and terminal security lines.
How does TZX compare to Rize-Artvin (RZV)?

[Trabzon Airport (TZX)](https://dhmi.gov.tr/sayfalar/havalimani/trabzon/anasayfa.aspx) offers more frequent daily flights and car rental choices, making it the practical base for Trabzon, Sümela Monastery, and Uzungöl. Opened in May 2022, [Rize-Artvin Airport (RZV)](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Rizeartvin/AnaSayfa.aspx) operates 24 hours on reclaimed sea land per [DHMİ Rize-Artvin specifications](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Rizeartvin/GenelBilgiler.aspx) and cuts 90 to 120 minutes off drives to Fırtına Valley, Ayder, and Artvin.

For multi-day eastern Black Sea itineraries, an open-jaw routing works best: fly into TZX to cover Trabzon, Sümela, and Uzungöl, then continue east through Rize and the Kaçkar foothills before flying out of RZV. faq.q: How far is Trabzon Airport from Havaş stops in the city?
faq.a: Havaş shuttles depart directly outside the TZX arrivals exit and run west into central Trabzon toward Beşirli, as well as east along the coast. Schedules align with incoming domestic flights.

faq.q: Can I visit Sümela Monastery on the same day I land at TZX?
faq.a: Yes. If your flight lands before 11:00, a pre-booked private driver can take you straight to Altındere Valley in about 55 minutes, hold your luggage in the vehicle, and drop you at your hotel afterward.

faq.q: Are domestic and international terminals separate at Trabzon Airport?
faq.a: Trabzon Airport operates adjacent domestic and international terminal sections connected by a short outdoor walk. Check your boarding pass carefully before unloading luggage at curbside drop-off.

faq.q: When is the best weather window for Black Sea yayla transfers?
faq.a: Late May through September offers the clearest mountain access, though rain and valley fog occur year-round. Higher plateaus above 2,000 meters often remain snowbound until early June.

faq.q: Can you rent a car at TZX and drop it off at Rize-Artvin Airport (RZV)?
faq.a: Major national chains at TZX sometimes allow one-way rentals to RZV for a drop fee, but availability tightens in summer. Confirm one-way return rules in writing before booking flights.

faq.q: Are taxis readily available for late-night arrivals at TZX?
faq.a: Yes, official yellow taxis wait outside the arrivals hall around the clock. For trips beyond central Trabzon, agree on the metered route or pre-book a fixed-rate licensed transfer in advance.
